name: Arrow Cutting
summary: The Tao-shih can intercept arrows and similarly paced projectile weapons. At difficulty 7, the practitioner deflects the projectile. At difficulty 9, the practitioner catches it and may throw it back with the next action. This does not normally work against bullets.

name: Hurricane Throw
summary: The practitioner catches or grabs an opponent and hurls them with extraordinary force. Resolve it like a martial-arts throw, but add one damage die for every success on the attack roll. Unlike most unarmed Do attacks, this technique inflicts bashing damage.

name: Iron Shirt
summary: Intense conditioning and focused chi allow the practitioner to withstand powerful blows. Add the character's Do rating to bashing soak rolls. It cannot normally soak lethal damage unless the Cinematic Damage option is in use. A blow that inflicts more damage than the character's Stamina still causes at least one health level.
roll: Adds Do Trait to soak roll

name: Kiaijutsu
summary: Once per combat, the practitioner channels chi through the voice to produce one of three effects: Stamina, Terror, or Eloquence.
roll: Stamina + Do / Manipulation + Do / Charisma + Do
details: Stamina: Roll Stamina + Do, difficulty 7. Each success grants +1 Stamina for three turns.

Terror: Roll Manipulation + Do against the target's Willpower +3. Each success adds +1 difficulty to the target's next action, maximum +3. If successes exceed the target's Willpower, the target may be stunned or driven to flee. Against opponents with Willpower 4 or less, one opponent may flee per success.
Eloquence: Roll Charisma + Do, difficulty 8. Each success adds one success to the next Expression, Leadership, Intimidation, or performance-based Art roll.

name: Plum Flower Blossom
summary: Through exceptional balance and acrobatic training, the practitioner can double normal jumping distance or bounce between objects for one turn, plus one additional turn for every two successes. Using one of these leaps as an attack increases the attack's difficulty by 1 and adds two damage dice. Leaping and attacking remain separate actions.
damage: N/A; an attack made from the leap gains +2 damage dice
actions: 1; leaping and attacking together require separate actions

name: Soft Fist
summary: The practitioner catches a hand-to-hand attack and redirects it into the original attacker or another nearby target. The practitioner must score more successes than the attacker. Excess successes beyond those needed to catch the attack become additional damage dice.

name: Ten Thousand Weapons
summary: In the practitioner's hands, almost any object can become a weapon. A normally harmless object inflicts one die of bashing damage per dot of Do. A weapon that normally inflicts bashing damage instead inflicts lethal damage. A weapon that already inflicts lethal damage gains one additional damage die.
difficulty: N/A; use the difficulty appropriate to the attack
damage: Improvised object: Do/B; bashing weapon becomes lethal; lethal weapon gains +1 damage die

name: Typhoon Kick
summary: The practitioner focuses chi and momentum into a devastating kick capable of shattering solid objects. It may inflict bashing or lethal damage and can be used only once every five turns. If the practitioner strikes a solid object or a target that soaks all the damage, the practitioner must soak or suffer half the attack's damage, rounded down.

name: Weapon Art
summary: The practitioner applies Do mastery to familiar hand-to-hand weapons. The character gains one familiar weapon for every dot of Melee. With those weapons, reduce the normal attack difficulty by 1, and weapons that normally inflict bashing damage may inflict lethal damage. Arrow Cutting may be used with these weapons, although a weapon cannot be used to catch a projectile. Bows and thrown weapons qualify, but guns do not. The character's Dexterity + Do pool must be at least as high as Dexterity + Melee.
difficulty: N/A; normal weapon difficulty reduced by 1
damage: As weapon; bashing damage may be converted to lethal

name: Butterfly Palms
summary: Trains both sides of the body to attack, defend, and move together. When splitting actions, restore one die to one reduced dice pool.

name: Peaceful Way
summary: Applies Do's discipline to one Ability associated with the Eight Limbs, granting Do's reduced-difficulty benefit.

name: Broken Rhythm
summary: Uses irregular timing to disrupt an opponent's defense. The attack is harder, but the defender may suffer a penalty.

name: Iron Hand
summary: Conditions the hands to break objects and penetrate defenses. The target loses one soak die, but fine touch is impaired.

name: Jou Chuan - Soft Fist
summary: Redirects an incoming unarmed or melee attack into the attacker or another nearby opponent.

name: Escape Arts
summary: Uses flexibility and controlled dislocation to escape restraints. More secure restraints require a roll.

name: Dim Mak
summary: A pressure-point attack that can delay damage and may temporarily reduce a Physical Attribute.

name: Kongjin - Empty Force
summary: Projects force through chi so a strike can land without direct contact.

name: San He
summary: Coordinates body, mind, and spirit to channel internal force into exceptional physical performance.
